_comment: Contract between the deterministic matching engine and the presentation layer. Every field is produced by the engine. Claude may author ONLY the fields marked llm_authored:true, and may never alter rank, match_score, or the candidate set.

user_profile.plain_language: Covering 4 people in Lagos on about ₦600,000 a year. Surgery and maternity are critical, hospital choice matters a lot, and you'd rather pay more than risk a big bill.
user_profile.not_scored_reason: No public benefit data exists for these across the plans we hold.

recommendations.match_score_note: Scored on 4 of your 8 stated priorities.

price.over_budget_note: This is above the ₦600,000 you set. We're showing it because it scored highest on surgery and hospital access.

provider_access.caveat: We can't yet confirm which hospitals near you in Lagos accept this exact plan. Call before you pay.

warnings.text: At ₦480,380 per person, covering 4 people costs roughly ₦1.92m — more than triple your budget.
The ₦400,000 surgery limit is modest next to the ₦2,500,000 inpatient limit. Inpatient cover and surgery cover are not the same thing.
Hygeia's family plans don't state how many people they cover, so we've priced this per person.

potential_gap.display: You said you'd want ₦2,000,000 of surgical protection. This plan covers ₦400,000. Potential gap: ₦1,600,000.
potential_gap.disclaimer: This is an analytical estimate based on published limits — not a prediction of what you would actually pay.

drivers: Price verified against a dated screenshot — our strongest evidence
No provider-level confirmation for your area
4 of your 8 priorities could not be scored
evidence_confidence.note: Confidence describes our evidence, not the quality of this plan.

why_it_matches._constraint: Claude writes 3-5 plain-language reasons from THIS object only. No new facts. No comparative claims about HMOs not in this result set.

gaps._constraint: Claude restates warnings + potential_gap + unscored dimensions in plain language. Never minimises.

verification_questions: Does [my hospital] currently accept Hygeia HyPrime Plus — not just Hygeia?
What exactly is covered under the ₦400,000 major surgery limit, and what falls outside it?
Is there a waiting period before surgery or maternity cover starts?
What is the total annual premium for 4 people, and is that per person or combined?
Which of my medications are on your formulary?

alternatives.flag_text: ₦117,420 versus Red Beryl's ₦92,340 — 27% more money for double the surgery limit (₦300,000 vs ₦150,000). If surgery protection is your priority, the cheaper plan may be the more expensive choice.
alternatives.critical_warning: Major surgery cover on Reliance plans does not begin until month 15 of your policy.

could_not_compare.headline: 6 HMOs don't publish enough for us to compare them
could_not_compare.explanation: These organisations don't publish retail premiums or benefit limits publicly. That's not evidence they're bad — it means we can't check. Here's what to ask them.

known_facts: Part of SUNU Group, 17+ African countries
Advertises 'No Financial Limit to Cover' — ask what that means per service

what_to_ask: What is the annual premium for my exact family size?
What is the major surgery limit — the actual figure, not the overall limit?
